facts_found: To open a Rho-Bank business checking account, the customer must be verified, have at least one existing personal checking account with status OPEN, not exceed 6 business checking accounts, have no accounts with status CLOSED, and have an existing checking account balance of at least $500. Navy Blue business checking has a $0.00 monthly maintenance fee, 0.5% APY, no minimum balance requirement, unlimited digital transfers within a $25,000 daily limit, optional overdraft settings, and free e-statements. [doc_business_checking_accounts_navy_blue_001]

Navy Blue charges $15.00 per domestic wire transfer, $5.00 per same-day ACH transfer, $2.50 per U.S. out-of-network ATM withdrawal, and 3% with a $5.00 minimum for foreign ATM withdrawals; standard ACH and paper statements are $0.00. [doc_business_checking_accounts_navy_blue_008]

Navy Blue referral program pays $100 to the referrer and $75 to the referred business, up to 10 referrals per year, if the referred business deposits $5,000 within 90 days and the referrer has been a Rho-Bank checking customer for 60 days. [doc_business_checking_accounts_navy_blue_001]

Cobalt Blue business checking has a $20.00 monthly maintenance fee waived when the daily balance is at least $2,500, earns 0.5% APY, and includes a monthly free transaction allotment documented as $175 free transactions per month with $0.25 charged for excess transactions. Cobalt Blue does not assess overdraft fees. [doc_business_checking_accounts_cobalt_blue_009]

True Blue business checking has a $75.00 monthly maintenance fee waived at a $50,000 balance, a $25,000 minimum balance requirement to maintain the account and access premium features, and a $25.00 per-occurrence overdraft fee. [doc_business_checking_accounts_true_blue_002]

Hunter Green referral program pays $175 to the referrer and $125 to the referred business, up to 10 referral bonuses per year, with a $10,000 qualifying deposit within 90 days and a 60-day checking relationship requirement. [doc_business_checking_accounts_hunter_green_001]

Sky Blue ease-of-use setup includes an online application, upload of company formation documents and ownership details, user roles, spending controls, alerts, and linking external accounts for transfers. [doc_business_checking_accounts_sky_blue_001]
Sky Blue perks include $2,750 AWS credits and a 12.0% Stripe payment-processing discount. [doc_business_checking_accounts_sky_blue_003]
Sky Blue referral program pays $150 to the referrer and $250 to the referred startup, up to 8 referrals per year. [doc_business_checking_accounts_sky_blue_001]

Lime Green referral program pays $200 to the referrer and $150 to the referred business, up to 12 referrals per year, with a $15,000 qualifying deposit within 90 days and a 90-day checking relationship requirement. [doc_business_checking_accounts_lime_green_003]

[doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_004]

Internal docs instruct that the agent calls these tools directly to perform actions on behalf of the customer and must not expose tool details to the customer — i.e., account opening can be completed by the agent. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_004]

Debit cards can only be ordered for checking accounts (account_type must be 'checking') that are OPEN, have been open at least 3 business days, hold a minimum balance of $25, with at most 1 active card per checking account and a valid US domestic address.
